event.name: Debounced Trigger
event.description: A Debounce key stayed quiet for its window (LAST_TRIGGER_KEY says which)

event.name: Throttled Trigger
event.description: A Throttle key fired (LAST_TRIGGER_KEY says which)

event.name: Once Per Day Passed
event.description: A Once Per Day key passed for the first time today (ONCE_KEY says which)

event.name: Timer Expired
event.description: A named timer expired (LAST_TIMER_KEY says which; LAST_TIMER_LATE is True after a restart)

event.name: State Changed
event.description: The state machine moved (CURRENT_STATE and PREVIOUS_STATE)

event.name: Counter Changed
event.description: A counter changed (LAST_COUNTER_KEY and LAST_COUNTER_VALUE)

event.name: Flag Changed
event.description: A flag was set or cleared (LAST_FLAG_KEY and LAST_FLAG_VALUE)

event.name: Pack Read-Only
event.description: The SmartBuildOS licence halted the pack: commands are refused, reads still work

event.name: Pack Restored
event.description: The pack is active again after a read-only period

event.name: Blocks Restore Failed
event.description: The stored Logic Blocks could not be read at startup. Nothing was reset; see Blocks Status

event.name: Blocks Configuration Applied
event.description: A block was created, changed, enabled, disabled or retired in Composer

command.name: INCREMENT_COUNTER
command.description: Add BY (default 1) to the counter named KEY

command.name: DECREMENT_COUNTER
command.description: Subtract BY (default 1) from the counter named KEY

command.name: SET_COUNTER
command.description: Set the counter named KEY to VALUE

command.name: RESET_COUNTER
command.description: Set the counter named KEY back to 0

command.name: SET_FLAG
command.description: Set the flag named KEY

command.name: CLEAR_FLAG
command.description: Clear the flag named KEY

command.name: TOGGLE_FLAG
command.description: Toggle the flag named KEY

command.name: SET_STATE
command.description: Move the state machine to STATE (fires State Changed only when it differs)

command.name: DEBOUNCE
command.description: Restart the quiet timer for KEY; Debounced Trigger fires once KEY has been quiet for MILLISECONDS

command.name: THROTTLE
command.description: Fire Throttled Trigger for KEY now unless it fired within the last MILLISECONDS

command.name: ONCE_PER_DAY
command.description: Fire Once Per Day Passed for KEY the first time today (local calendar day)

command.name: START_TIMER
command.description: Start (or restart) the timer named KEY; Timer Expired fires after SECONDS

command.name: CANCEL_TIMER
command.description: Cancel the timer named KEY (nothing fires)

command.name: RESET_ALL
command.description: Reset counters, flags, timers or everything

command.name: BLOCK_TRIGGER
command.description: Run the rule of BLOCK: cooldown, quiet period, once per day, timer start, or a gate's conditions

command.name: BLOCK_START
command.description: Start the countdown of the timer in BLOCK (follows its Repeated Start setting)

command.name: BLOCK_RESTART
command.description: Start the countdown of the timer in BLOCK again from now

command.name: BLOCK_CANCEL
command.description: Cancel what is pending in BLOCK: a countdown, a quiet period or a change waiting to hold

command.name: BLOCK_SET
command.description: Set BLOCK to VALUE: a flag (true/false), a counter (whole number), a state selector (state name) or a threshold reading

command.name: BLOCK_CLEAR
command.description: Turn the flag in BLOCK off, or set the counter in BLOCK to 0

command.name: BLOCK_TOGGLE
command.description: Flip the flag in BLOCK

command.name: BLOCK_INCREMENT
command.description: Add BY (default 1) to the counter in BLOCK

command.name: BLOCK_DECREMENT
command.description: Subtract BY (default 1) from the counter in BLOCK

command.name: BLOCK_RESET
command.description: Make BLOCK forget its history: the cooldown, today's pass, the count, the state. Nothing fires for a cleared countdown

command.name: BLOCK_INPUT
command.description: Send VALUE to INPUT of BLOCK (true/false for conditions, a number for a threshold, a state for a stable filter)

command.name: BLOCK_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE
command.description: Tell BLOCK that INPUT cannot be read right now. The block's result becomes unknown, not false

property.name: Blocks
property.description: Which block is in which slot. Programming uses the slot number (Block 01, Block 02, ...).

property.name: Dealer App
property.description: Open this address in a browser on the same network. It reports and simulates; it cannot change a block.

property.name: Dealer App Access
property.description: Off closes the controller port the dealer app is served from.

property.name: App Relay Address
property.description: The controller address the dealer app is opened on. Leave on auto unless Dealer App says the address is unknown.

property.name: Cloud Status Mirror
property.description: On sends a summary (names, types, health) to SmartBuildOS through the Agent. Off sends nothing. Not yet verified end to end on a controller.

property.name: New Block Name
property.description: Type a name, pick a type, then run New Draft.

property.name: Template
property.description: A recipe to start from. Run Load Template Into Draft. Devices are never part of a template.

property.name: Selected Block
property.description: The block the Selected Block actions act on.

property.name: Draft
property.description: Nothing typed below reaches a live block until Apply Draft.

property.name: Draft Tag
property.description: Optional: a room or group, for the dealer app's filter.

property.name: Draft Notes
property.description: Optional dealer notes, shown in the dealer app.

property.name: Draft Duration
property.description: Written the way it is said: 10m, 90s, 1h30m, 500ms. A bare number is seconds.

property.name: Draft After Restart
property.description: What a running countdown does after a controller restart.

property.name: Draft Evaluation
property.description: Continuous output fires Became True / Became False. Gate a trigger passes BLOCK_TRIGGER only while the conditions hold.

property.name: Draft Counter Threshold
property.description: Optional whole number. Leave empty for a plain counter.

property.name: Draft States
property.description: State names separated by commas, for example Home, Away, Night.

property.name: Draft Transitions
property.description: Optional. From > To pairs separated by commas; * means any state. Empty allows every change.

property.name: Draft Input 1 Label
property.description: A name for this input. With no device picked it is fed by the BLOCK_INPUT command.

property.name: Draft Input 1 Device
property.description: Optional: read this input from a device variable instead of programming.

property.name: Draft Input 1 True When
property.description: Optional: the values that mean true, separated by commas (for example closed,1).

property.name: Draft Input 2 Label
property.description: A name for this input. With no device picked it is fed by the BLOCK_INPUT command.

property.name: Draft Input 2 Device
property.description: Optional: read this input from a device variable instead of programming.

property.name: Draft Input 2 True When
property.description: Optional: the values that mean true, separated by commas (for example closed,1).

property.name: Draft Input 3 Label
property.description: A name for this input. With no device picked it is fed by the BLOCK_INPUT command.

property.name: Draft Input 3 Device
property.description: Optional: read this input from a device variable instead of programming.

property.name: Draft Input 3 True When
property.description: Optional: the values that mean true, separated by commas (for example closed,1).

property.name: Draft Input 4 Label
property.description: A name for this input. With no device picked it is fed by the BLOCK_INPUT command.

property.name: Draft Input 4 Device
property.description: Optional: read this input from a device variable instead of programming.

property.name: Draft Input 4 True When
property.description: Optional: the values that mean true, separated by commas (for example closed,1).

property.name: Draft Feedback Device
property.description: Optional: a device variable that shows the equipment responded to this block's event.

property.name: Draft Feedback Expect
property.description: The values that mean it responded, separated by commas (for example 1,on).

property.name: Draft Adopt Legacy Key
property.description: Optional, new Flag or Counter only: copy the value of a free-form key in once. Nothing is adopted unless this is filled in.

property.name: Draft Impact
property.description: What Apply Draft would do to anything that is running.
